parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer type.command: set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer type external

set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer peer.command: set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer peer-as 100

set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer neig.command: set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer neighbor 10.1.2.2

set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer fami.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer fami.command: set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer family inet unicast

set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer fami.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast prefix-limit [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer fami.command: set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer family inet unicast prefix-limit 10.1.2.0/24
set protocols bgp group CE2_to_Peer fami.explanation: 配置BGP组IPv4单播的前缀限制。
